steps.content:
The two listings are the same in every way I can see, so I can't give you a real reason to pick one seller over the other.

| | Ottervale Audio (a) | Brackmoor Sound (b) |
|---|---|---|
| Product | Quellwyn Stillwave H2 | Quellwyn Stillwave H2 |
| Price | $129.00 | $129.00 |
| Shipping | Free, 3–5 business days | Free, 3–5 business days |
| Stock | In stock | In stock |
| Returns | 30 days, buyer pays return shipping | 30 days, buyer pays return shipping |
| Warranty | 1 year limited | 1 year limited |
| Rating | 4.3/5 (210 reviews) | 4.3/5 (210 reviews) |
| Specs and box contents | Same | Same |

The rating and review count are also identical. They may be a shared product rating and not a rating of each seller, so they may not say anything about the seller itself.

Since the listings don't separate them, you could check a few things elsewhere:
- **Seller reputation:** Look up each seller's own reviews on a third-party site. Look for complaints about shipping delays, counterfeit items or slow refunds.
- **Authorized retailer status:** Check whether Quellwyn's website lists either seller as an authorized reseller. This can affect whether the warranty is honored.
- **Contact and policies:** See whether either seller gives a clear support contact, a physical address and full return terms.
- **Final price:** Compare the cart totals at checkout, in case one adds tax or fees.

If both check out, either is fine. I'd go with whichever has the better independent seller reviews, or just pick one.
